 WBBL 2026: Match 25, AS W vs SS W Match Prediction – Who will win today’s WBBL match between Adelaide Strikers Women vs Sydney Sixers Women?
 Adelaide Strikers Women will take on the Sydney Sixers Women in Match 25 of the Women's Big Bash League (WBBL) 2026 on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at the Karen Rolton Oval in Adelaide.
 By CricTracker Staff Published - 16 Nov 2026, 18:13 IST 
 6 Min Read
 Sydney Sixers Women and Adelaide Strikers Women. (Photo Source: Getty Images) Adelaide Strikers Women will take on the Sydney Sixers Women in Match 25 of the Women's Big Bash League (WBBL) 2026 on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at the Karen Rolton Oval in Adelaide.
 Tahlia McGrath's Strikers side have recovered themselves after an early wobble, and are coming into this clash after wins over the Hobart Hurricanes and Perth Scorchers.
 The defending champions suffered their first loss of the season at the hands of the Melbourne Renegades in the last clash, and will be looking to recover from their mid-season blip

 Karen Rolton Oval, Adelaide: Pitch Report
 The Karen Rolton Oval in Adelaide has seen just one match so far this season, with the Strikers securing a victory batting first. The wicket is expected to play consistently, with batters able to play their shots with relative ease. Bowlers will have to ensure they get their lengths right, but can get purchase off the surface in the form of grip and turn for the spinners.

 Probable Top Performers from AS W vs SS W
 Probable Best Batter: Ashleigh Gardner
 Ashleigh Gardner has been in fine form with the bat all season, having scored 301 runs in six games, at a strike rate of 183.54. She recorded her third fifty-plus score of the season to rescue the Sixers after a collapse against the Renegades. She has been the leading run-scorer of the season and will be looking to extend her dominant run.
 Probable Best Bowler: Ashleigh Gardner
 The 2026 season of the WBBL has so far belonged to the Sixers skipper, who also leads the wickets tally for the season. Gardner's off-spin has accounted for 15 wickets in the six games she has played. She took her best figures for the season against the Renegades of 4 for 33, and will be a force to reckon with for the Strikers.
 Today's Match Prediction : Defending team to win the match, Sixers to hold the edge in the contest
